name: buttes
title: The Buttes
description: Three buttes for The Searchers: a mitten with its thumb, a spire and a lower butte, each on a stepped talus of sand and nougat, rising in bands of reddish brown and dark orange with fluted ribs at uneven heights, capped with nougat plates tied in three layers.
